text:
Woman, Shall we visit the museum this afternoon?
Man, Yes. The exhibition starts at two, but let's leave at eleven so we can have lunch first.
Woman, Good idea. Should we buy the tickets online?
Man, No, we can buy them at the ticket office when we arrive.
